dimension_evidence.page: p.7, Physical characteristics; product photographs pp.1,2,4
dimension_evidence.uncertainty: Manufacturer rounded metric closed-lid envelope, approx. 1 mm precision. Left electronics pod, hinged lid and four portrait plate positions traced by proportion from facility/manufacturer photos. Lid angle and orbital excursion are illustrative, not verified hardware limits.

author: Biofoundry project / Codex
license: CC0-1.0 (original project geometry only; manufacturer and facility references retain their own rights)
notes: Exact LogPhase 600 exterior: broad white housing, narrower left electronics pod, long rear-hinged right lid and two circular front indicators.
Lid opens about its real rear hinge; four plate nests are on an XY orbital shaker represented by two prismatic joints, not a spinning plate rack.
Neutral pose has closed lid and stated closed dimensions. Raise lid by rotation around negative local X to reveal four numbered plate nests.
This is a visual digital asset; incubation, OD600 measurement, hardware motion and workflow integration remain unvalidated.
axis: X right, Y back, Z up in Blender; standard Y-up glTF export

review.method: Actual final-model render inspected beside facility/manufacturer reference; no photographic texture substitution
review.note: Long four-plate shaker lid, narrow left electronics pod and indicators reviewed; closed/open manufacturer reference agrees; orbit/range not hardware calibrated.
review.final_review_note: Final evaluated-geometry render reviewed after curve-envelope correction and modifier-preserving export. Shapes compared with the previously inspected facility/manufacturer contact sheets.
review.approval_policy: Visual approval binds to the exact exported GLB (geometry, materials, hierarchy and animation); PNG date/render-time metadata may change without changing the reviewed model.

surface_check.method: Actual evaluated vertices to triangles in both directions, closed pose; Euclidean metres; all posed transforms independently checked

assembly.units: m at asset root; local translation units follow accumulated parent scale
assembly.axis_metadata: joint_axis uses Blender Z-up node local coordinates; glTF Y-up equivalent is [x,z,-y]
